analysis.title: Comstock Resources Inc. (CRK): First Take: In-Line Quarter Versus GS and Consensus; Focus on Western Haynesville Outlook With SOCAR
key_insights: CRK 3Q26 EBITDAX was $266 mn vs GS estimate $263 mn and FactSet consensus $263 mn, an in-line quarter.
3Q26 adjusted EPS was $0.02 vs GS estimate $0.05 and consensus $0.04. Free cash flow was ($175) mn vs GS ($189) mn and consensus ($196) mn.
Total production was 1.33 Bcfe/d vs GS 1.33 and consensus 1.35 Bcfe/d. Capex was $383 mn vs GS $391 mn and consensus $396 mn.
Net debt at 3Q26 end was $3.34 bn vs $3.05 bn at 2Q26 end.
4Q26 guidance: production 1.38-1.50 Bcfe/d vs GS 1.42 and consensus 1.43 Bcfe/d. Capex $125-$225 mn vs consensus $216 mn. Unit operating cost $0.69-$0.84 per Mcfe vs GS $0.76.
GS keeps a Sell rating and a $14 12-month price target on CRK, based on a DCF using a mid-cycle Henry Hub price of $3.50/MMBtu. The stock closed at $13.38 on 4 Nov 2026, implying 4.6% upside.

Key questions for the 11 AM ET call: the gas price needed to reinstate the quarterly dividend after the SOCAR transaction and deleveraging, gross Western Haynesville volume growth through 2030, 2027 leasing and appraisal updates, 2027 net capex under the SOCAR and Drilling JV agreements, and 2027 service cost inflation in the Haynesville.
Realized natural gas price was $2.93/Mcf vs GS $2.99/Mcf. Realized oil price was $87.43/bbl vs GS $82.11/bbl.
Total cash costs were $0.80/Mcfe vs GS $0.85/Mcfe. Lease operating cost was $0.23 vs GS $0.30, and gathering and transportation was $0.41 vs GS $0.35.

market_movers.rationale: In-line quarter on EBITDAX. Price target rests on a DCF with a $3.50/MMBtu mid-cycle Henry Hub price. Upside risks are higher gas prices, favorable Western Haynesville well results and lower costs.

3Q26 operating cash flow $208 mn reported vs GS est $202 mn and consensus est $207 mn. Cash flow per share $0.71 vs GS est $0.69 and consensus est $0.70.

Net debt $3.34 bn at 3Q26 end vs $3.05 bn at 2Q26 end. GS had estimated $3.25 bn and consensus $3.24 bn.
4Q26 guidance (management): production 1.38-1.50 Bcfe/d vs GS est 1.42 and consensus est 1.43. Capex $125-$225 mn vs consensus est $216 mn. Unit operating cost $0.69-$0.84 per Mcfe vs GS est $0.76.

macro_indicators.indicator: Henry Hub natural gas mid-cycle price (GS DCF assumption)
macro_indicators.interpretation: Long-run price assumption used in the CRK DCF valuation. Realized gas price in 3Q26 was $2.93/Mcf, below this level.

risk_factors: Upside risks to the Sell call: higher natural gas prices, favorable well results (particularly in Western Haynesville) and lower costs.
Net debt rose to $3.34 bn from $3.05 bn in one quarter, and GS forecasts negative FCF yield of (13.6)% for 12/26E.
Quarterly dividend is currently not paid (0.0% dividend yield), and reinstatement depends on the gas price environment after the SOCAR transaction.
